text:
maria_sales: Hey team — AegisCorp (enterprise payer) signed the NDA and wants a 2-week POC to validate claims extraction + long-context QA. They will process PHI and want private deployment (VPC/on-prem option). Main asks: which model/variant to use, any compatibility blockers for 4k->64k inputs, ballpark pricing for ~500k gen tokens/day + 200k embedding calls/day, and answers for their security questionnaire (KMS, SOC2, retention). Can someone own tech presales and run a compatibility scan? cc @eli_engineering :wave:

eli_engineering: I can take the scan. Quick notes up-front: for long-context + extraction we should prefer an instruction-tuned long-context variant with strong retrieval/rerank support. My immediate candidates from our catalog to try: chronos-30b-64k-q4f32 (quantized 64k variant), chronos-30b-8k (faster, cheaper, less context), and llama-2-70b-q4f (if they need better instruction-following and hallucination control).

eli_engineering: Compatibility scan plan: run perf + memory + kv-cache sanity tests on their payload distribution (avg doc ~12k, 95p ~48k). I’ll run this command against staging infra:```bash
redwoodctl model-scan --model chronos-30b-64k-q4f32 --tests perf,kvcache,oom --payload-sample s3://aegis-poc/samples.json
```Should get initial perf profile + OOM signals in ~24-48h.

sophie_research: +1 to chronos-30b-64k for initial run. Also recommend adding a small retrieval eval and a hallucination metric (precision@k on extraction). For hallucination mitigation we should: 1) enable source-attribution + reranker, 2) use conservative temperature for final pass, 3) add rule-based postfilter for entity extraction. I can craft a 50-case eval set if you want.

maria_sales: That would be great, @sophie_research — Aegis will provide 100 sample claims and expected extractions by EOD. Timeline: customer wants POC kickoff on Mon. Is 48h verification fast enough to confirm feasibility before kickoff?

eli_engineering: If we start now, I can get a basic perf/oom + kvcache report in ~36 hours; full eval + regression checks ~72 hours. If there's a blocker (OOM or kernel mismatch) we'll know within the first run.

tyler_sre: Heads up on infra for private deployment: 64k context with chronos-30b-64k-q4f32 typically needs >=80GB GPU memory (H100/A100-80G preferred) for reasonable batch sizes. Quantized q4f32 helps, but KV cache for many long sessions drives RAM/VRAM. For Dedicated we should size for peak concurrency — ask Aegis about concurrent inference sessions. Also need to confirm VPC peering and egress limits.

kiran_security: On the questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 Type II report (enterprise package) and support CMKs via AMS/Azure/GCP KMS integrations for Private. Data retention: configurable per-customer; we offer retention policies and delete-on-request for PII/PHI. Audit logs and access logs are available for the Private control plane. I’ll prepare a short answers doc for their security team. Any specific checkpoints they asked about?

maria_sales: They specifically asked: 1) where keys are stored (customer KMS preferred), 2) are model weights sent to third parties (no), 3) do we allow on-prem box (yes, with package), 4) pen-test cadence and red-team access.

kiran_security: Got it. I’ll add KMS architecture diagram and our pen-test schedule (annual + on-demand for enterprise) to the answers. Also note: for on-prem we provide a HSM/KMS integration guide and can do a security walkthrough.

maria_sales: Pricing (ballpark) — can someone give me a quick hosted vs Dedicated estimate so I can set customer expectations?

eli_engineering: Ballpark numbers (very rough): Hosted (managed API) for that usage profile: ~$12k–$18k/mo depending on sequence length and streaming overhead. Dedicated reserved capacity (single-pool sized for 64k chronos at moderate concurrency): ~$40k–$70k/mo + infra; on-prem one-time infra + license. I’ll ask finance for a formal quote.

maria_sales: Perfect. Action items: eli -> run compatibility scan (owner), sophie -> prepare 50-case hallucination extraction eval, tyler -> confirm GPU sizing + network reqs, kiran -> draft security answers. I'll make a private #sales-aegis-poc channel and invite the customer success lead. Thanks :) :raised_hands:

redwood-bot: Note: scan job queued on staging cluster (job id: scan-67321). ETA 36h.
